description: Creates the DNS validation record for the HTTPS certificate (AWS ACM) of a domain already connected to AgentVerse. The record must stay in place for automatic renewal.
variableDescription: acmname: hash of the validation label issued by AWS ACM for this host, without the leading underscore (the template fixes the `_` prefix; e.g. 889f9143c49cad09f707fc6edb0b9470). acmvalue: the ACM-issued CNAME target without the fixed .acm-validations.aws suffix (e.g. _0748e842fa22593e475622a262f13596.jkddzztszm).
